name: Samian Labs beta
summary: Samian Labs is a thrilling multiplayer VR horror game created by popular content creator SamLeon68. This experience seamlessly combines fast-paced, physics-based gorilla-style movement with a dark, terrifying atmosphere. Players must closely work together inside a creepy, mysterious laboratory setting to outrun horrifying monsters, solve secrets, and survive. Gather your friends right now, master your momentum, and prepare for ultimate jumpscares before you become the next failed experiment inside the lab.
